column1: # The port's own Japanese texts, unofficial: the US texts the Japanese ROMs have no text of, written for the port in the
# game's register (config/language_exceptions_*_ja.tsv says which texts take them). A row: a key, the language (ja),
# the text, as in config/language_own.tsv: the Japanese font's characters as UTF-8 (kana; full-width letters, digits
# and marks, an ASCII one standing for its full-width form; no lower-case letter), the kanji of the game's kanji font,
# \n a line break, \stop the end of a box, \col(N) a colour (N hexadecimal), \\ a backslash, \xNN any other byte. A
# line holds sixteen characters at most.
# Ages' Goron fortune teller (TX_3142-TX_3159): an opening for the future, then each fortune, which calls it (\x0f\x42),
